2367.text: Called to give life, spouses share in the creative power and fatherhood of God. Married couples should regard it as their proper mission to transmit human life and to educate their children; they should realize that they are thereby cooperating with the love of God the Creator and are, in a certain sense, its interpreters. [...]
2367.notes: First two sentences (quoting GS 50). Ch. 10 birth section, the loss of a child.
